method.groundEstimate: max solved toe Y over 94 frames (y-down canvas == world for fixed-camera in_place demo)
method.velocity: central difference (f+1 - f-1)/2 on solved toe/ankle; gait tracks cyclic period 26
method.beltEstimate: mean toe vx at frames where toe height <= 1 px (the belt-locked bottom instant)
method.windows: taken from CONTACT_HEIGHT_WINDOWS (contact-height windows; independent of the per-frame reviewed intervals)

decision.note: Measurements only; no stance asserted here. Phase 2.2b evidence review finalized the labels in contacts.ts (touchdown/stance/toeOff per window).
